title: Ask HN: Why are so many rolling out their own AI/LLM agent sandboxing solution?
summary_zh: 这篇Hacker News讨论帖探讨了为何许多开发者选择自己构建AI/LLM编程智能体的沙盒隔离方案，反映了当前AI安全工具链的缺失，并试图定义一个「足够好」的标准沙盒应具备哪些特性。
summary: 这篇Hacker News讨论帖探讨了为何许多开发者选择自己构建AI/LLM编程智能体的沙盒隔离方案，反映了当前AI安全工具链的缺失，并试图定义一个「足够好」的标准沙盒应具备哪些特性。
highlights: Reveals the lack of standardized, out-of-the-box sandboxing solutions for autonomous AI coding agents.
Highlights the security risks and practical needs driving developers to DIY custom isolation environments (Docker, VMs, firejail).
